name: End of Day
description: Eight gentle questions for closing out the day, with optional notes that stay on this device.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: Eight gentle questions for the end of a work day, shown on Reflection Prompts.
help.goal: There is nothing to finish. Think about one prompt or all eight.
howToPlay: Read the prompt and take a moment with it.
If you like, type a few words in the notes box. They stay on this device.
Press Next for another prompt, or Back to return.
Press Clear my notes whenever you want a clean slate.
tips: Skip any prompt that does not suit you today.
